title.narrative: Demonstration of Guangxi Elderly Care and Healthcare Integration and Public-Provtae Partnership Project

description.narrative: The proposed project aims to support Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region (GZAR) to promote, coordinate, and deliver integrated elderly care and health care services to provide continued care for those in need. It will serve as a demonstration for the People's Republic of China (PRC) of an integrated elderly care and health care system and will be the first project in GZAR to introduce internationally accepted public-private partnership (PPP) principles and standards in the elderly care sector.

Output: Coordinated care services and facilities improved Indicator: A medical facility with age-friendly design and gender-sensitive facility use constructed Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: The medical facility with age-friendly and gender-sensitive design has completed all design and approval stages and is under active construction. The main structure is finished, and procurement of specialized equipment is ongoing, with full completion and operation expected by the end of 2025. Data Source: Semiannual project monitoring reports of GPMO

Output: Coordinated care services and facilities improved Indicator: At least 250 elderly care-related staff trained (of which 60% are women) report improved skills in elderly care Achievement: 279 Progress/Status: A total of 251 participants(217 women, 86.5%) were trained. These staff members reported improved skills in elderly care following the training. Data Source: Semiannual project monitoring reports of GPMO

Output: Coordinated care services and facilities improved Indicator: At least 300 therapists and other related staff of PIEs and elderly care institutions who were trained in occupational and physical therapy report improved skills Achievement: 283 Progress/Status: A total of 192 (173 female, 90%) staff participated in “Functional Assessment” training, 251(217 female, 86%) in “Rehabilitation” and “Promoting Nursing Coordination,” and 281(269 female, 96%) in “Clinical Integration and Multidisciplinary, with feedback confirming significant improvement in their skills. Data Source: Semiannual project monitoring reports of GPMO

Output: Coordinated care services and facilities improved Indicator: Four elderly care facilities with age-friendly design and gender-sensitive facility use constructed Achievement: 3 Progress/Status: Three elderly care facilities with age-friendly and gender-sensitive designs are under construction, with main structures mostly completed and some delays. Final completion and full operation are expected by the end of 2025. The BER for HZ2 is under revision upon ADB's comments. Data Source: Semiannual project monitoring reports of GPMO
